- Salary up to € 18,83 per hour (from 21 years)
- Long term employment possibilities
- Internal training opportunities

As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you are customer-friendly. You are also physically strong enough to lift heavy crates. What is also important:

- You have a B driving license;
- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transportation to work in Breda and Roosendaal.

Yum! :) Once you're going, your navigation will tell you exactly where to go! Have you arrived at your destination? Then you scan the groceries and deliver it to the door with a smile. The location where you will work as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn is Zoete Inval 6 in Breda. This is easy to reach with your own transport! You don't work alone, but together with a friendly team. Everyone has their own route, but beforehand everyone comes together for a cup of coffee.
